inviter_text: If you are an active Lantern Lab member and not an employee, invite one person who has never been a member. If they enroll and complete a $9 first payment by 14 February and it settles, you receive a three-visit equipment pass in your account within six days. Enroll by 14 February.
recipient_text: An active Lantern Lab member may invite you if you have never been a member. Enroll and complete the $9 first payment by 14 February. No recipient reward is offered. Enroll by 14 February.
short_disclosure: For an active, non-employee member inviting one never-member: the recipient must enroll and complete a $9 first payment by 14 February; after payment settles, the inviter receives a three-visit equipment pass in their account within six days. The recipient receives no reward.
ineligible_case_response: A person who is not an active Lantern Lab member or is an employee cannot be the inviter. A recipient who has previously been a member does not meet the supplied recipient condition.

fact_trace.draft_claim: Inviter must be active and not an employee.
Recipient must never have been a member.
$9 first payment must be completed by 14 February and settle.
Inviter receives a three-visit equipment pass in account within six days.

assumptions_or_conflicts.issue: No supplied conflict or missing material term identified.

scope_boundary: Draft copy guidance only; it does not authorize the program, decide eligibility, enroll anyone, send invitations, process payments, or issue or deliver rewards.
